# YourPetPass

> YourPetPass is a pet health records and travel planning app for dog and cat parents.
> It stores vaccination history, vet visit records, allergies, medications and travel documents in one place and provides AI-assisted travel planning with source links.

YourPetPass is built for pet parents who see multiple veterinarians, travel with pets, use boarding or daycare, relocate, or want a portable source of truth for pet health history.

## Editorial and source policy

YourPetPass travel guides distinguish destination-government requirements from airline carriage policies. Country entry/export/transit requirements should be verified against the responsible government authority. Editorial-team bylines are organizational identities, not individual veterinary professionals. AI output is a planning and organization aid, not veterinary care or official travel approval.

## Product privacy boundaries

- Emergency QR, when enabled, creates a tokenized, no-login emergency page with owner-selected supported fields; it is not a public pet directory and does not expose full medical records or private uploaded documents.
- AI document extraction and travel planning are assistance features. Extracted information should be reviewed before it is relied on or saved, and current travel requirements should be confirmed with the responsible government or carrier authority as applicable.
